concept: MISSION CONTROL: the viewer is dropped into a live herdr operations room. The world is diegetic terminal UI: panes, prompts, status lights. One agent stalls mid-scene, the save is typed out for real, the receipts land, the close is a command. The color world moves every beat: status greens and ambers, a red alert, a full herdr-blue flash, a two-tone split.
money_shot_note: the 26 count-up at scene 7 of 8, cashing in the red flip the viewer just watched get saved
transition_strategy: fade-through with accelerating exits and a compositor cut-kick; cuts land on onsets; sheens carry scene tails
music_direction: driving electronic, 110-140 bpm, cut with beat_align; fresh CC BY track (catalog was exhausted)

scenes.intent: poster frame plus world-setting: a wire report filed from mission control names the project instantly
scenes.copy_note: ticker HERDR WIRE, dateline mission control, headline names herdr and the herd
scenes.sound_cue: ticker ticks under the intro bar

scenes.intent: SHOW the product world: four live agent panes typing with status lights, and codex flips blocked-red mid-scene
scenes.copy_note: claude code, codex, cursor agent, amp with one-line activity each; codex flips at 78%
scenes.sound_cue: soft ticks per pane, alarm-adjacent thud on the flip
scenes.transition: hard cut on the flip's echo

scenes.intent: the save, as a full color break: herdr-blue floods the frame the instant the stall is caught
scenes.copy_note: one word CAUGHT with a caption about the stall

scenes.intent: the intervention typed for real: attach, approve, agent back to work, in a live prompt
scenes.copy_note: herdr attach codex, the pause reason, the y, back to work in accent

scenes.intent: positioning in one look: tmux sees panes, herdr sees agents, two-tone frame
scenes.copy_note: tmux blind panes versus herdr agent aware

scenes.intent: the receipts drawn live: the star curve climbs to its number
the scale lands as the peak: the count runs up while the red flip is still fresh
scenes.copy_note: 26 counting up, the herd named small underneath
scenes.sound_cue: hard hit as the count lands

scenes.intent: closing command that rhymes with the wire open so the loop replays clean
scenes.copy_note: run the herd, binary honesty in the subtitle
